Here's the handoff writeup — pull the full text into your doc as-is:

```
ON-CALL HANDOFF — Prod outage, 2026-07-04

ROOT CAUSE
Redis (10.0.0.12:6379) dropped at 02:14:07 UTC and never came back.
The app fell back to hitting the main data store directly for every
request. That store couldn't take the load, requests started timing
out at 5s each, and the request queue backed up without limit.
12 reconnect attempts over ~17 minutes all failed with ECONNREFUSED.
By 02:31:44 the backlog was large enough to OOM-kill worker-2, and
the supervisor killed the whole process group at 02:31:52 once the
api process stopped responding.

IMPACT WINDOW
02:14:07 - 02:31:52 UTC (about 17m45s of degraded/down service).

DEPENDENCY VERSION
No package-lock.json exists in the repo, so the exact resolved
ioredis version isn't recorded anywhere here. package.json pins
"^5.4.1" (anything 5.4.1 up to but under 6.0.0). Run `npm ls ioredis`
on the actual server to get the real installed version before
matching it against changelog fixes.

OPEN QUESTION
Why Redis at 10.0.0.12:6379 went down and stayed down for the full
window — not yet established from these logs.
```

Flagging the version gap again since it's still open: without a lock file or server access, this can't be nailed down further from here.
